question: Airedale International Air Conditioning Ltd parent company owner
markdown:
Airedale International Air Conditioning Ltd, founded by Alan Duttine and Peter Midgley, is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Modine Manufacturing Company, a US-based public company. Modine acquired Airedale in 2005 for about $38 million. Airedale operates as Airedale by Modine and is part of Modine's thermal management business.
Airedale International Air Conditioning Ltd was founded by Alan Duttine and Peter Midgley.
Airedale International's parent company is Modine Manufacturing Company.
Airedale is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Modine Manufacturing Company, a publicly-traded corporation headquartered in the United States.
Airedale by Modine is part of Modine (NYSE:MOD), a diversified global leader in thermal management technology and solutions.
Airedale International Air Conditioning was acquired by Modine Manufacturing on 16-May-2005.
Modine Manufacturing Co. acquired privately held Airedale International Air Conditioning Limited of Leeds, England, for approximately $38 million in cash.
Airedale by Modine is celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2024 and is owned by US-based Modine.
